reason: Seeing the cash drawer and cancelled bills from anywhere is genuinely useful with eight staff, and ₹999 a month is nothing for my salon. But nowhere does it say who picks up the phone when billing hangs on a Sunday with every chair full, and I am not paying ₹4,999 upfront to a company I have never heard of to find out.
objection: If the app stops working on a busy Sunday, my stylists will go back to cash and paper, my records will be half in the app and half in the register, and there is nobody to call. Also my senior staff are not comfortable in English.
would_change_my_mind: A named local person I can call or WhatsApp on Sundays, Hindi on the staff screens, and setup charged only after the free month if I keep it.
